paragraphs.text: 1. WE will, with Indra and all Gods to aid us, bring these existing worlds into subjection.
paragraphs.original: इमा नु कं भुवना सीषधामेन्द्रश्च विश्वे च देवाः
paragraphs.translit: imā nu kaṃ bhuvanā sīṣadhāmendraśca viśve ca devāḥ

paragraphs.text: 2. Our sacrifice, our bodies, and our offspring, let Indra form together with Adityas.
paragraphs.original: यज्ञं च नस्तन्वं च प्रजां चादित्यैरिन्द्रः सह चीकॢपाति
paragraphs.translit: yajñaṃ ca nastanvaṃ ca prajāṃ cādityairindraḥ saha cīkḷpāti

paragraphs.text: 3. With the Adityas, with the band of Maruts, may Indra be Protector of our bodies.
4. As when the Gods came, after they had slaughtered the Asuras, keeping safe their Godlike nature,
5. Brought the Sun hitherward with mighty powers, and looked about them on their vigorous Godhead.
